# Texas Sinus & Snoring

> Board-certified ENT practice in Houston, TX specializing in minimally-invasive sinus surgery, sleep apnea treatment, and nasal breathing solutions led by Dr. Benjamin Cilento.

Texas Sinus & Snoring is a comprehensive ENT practice serving the Houston area with expertise in advanced procedures like Balloon Sinuplasty, FESS, and FDA-approved Inspire Sleep Therapy. The practice combines surgical innovation with patient-centered care, offering both diagnostic services and cutting-edge treatment options for chronic sinus conditions, sleep apnea, and nasal obstruction.

## Sinus Surgery Procedures

- [Balloon Sinuplasty in Houston, TX | Texas Sinus & Snoring](https://texassinusandsnoring.com/services/sinus-surgery/balloon-sinuplasty): Minimally invasive Balloon Sinuplasty procedure for sinus relief
- [FESS Surgery in Houston, TX | Texas Sinus & Snoring](https://texassinusandsnoring.com/services/sinus-surgery/fess): Functional Endoscopic Sinus Surgery with CT guidance technology
- [Septoplasty in Houston, TX | Texas Sinus & Snoring](https://texassinusandsnoring.com/services/sinus-surgery/septoplasty): Septoplasty procedure for deviated septum and nasal obstruction
